insight: Bootstrapped solo by Maor Shlomo with no outside funding, then acquired by Wix for $80M within months of launch.
name: Base44
tagline: Describe an app in plain English and get a working full-stack product.
description: An AI no-code app builder that turns a conversational prompt into a fully functional web app — database, user auth, permissions, and hosting handled for you. It targets non-developers and founders who want to ship custom internal tools and products without writing code. Now operated by Wix following its 2025 acquisition.

modelSupport.notes: Generates full-stack apps; frontier models managed by the platform.

edge: Generates the database, auth, and hosting for each app automatically, so non-coders ship working tools end-to-end without wiring a backend.
pros: Full working apps from plain-English prompts
Free tier to start, no card required
cons: Credit usage can climb on complex apps

references.title: Solo entrepreneur's Base44 acquired by Wix for $80 million
